baseline.gap_data_provenance: Supplied offline tighter-side minima and available shadow lower ranges were not recomputed during plan preparation.

hypothesis: Current silhouette and rim measurements may tighten directional intervals enough to certify some exposures while retaining original size and pose uncertainty.
bounded_changes: Add a shadow estimate alongside the existing shadow baseline. Keep the failed single-ID8-plus-red certificate disabled.
Bind current observations to exposure, calibration, real open command and synchronized measured joint and finger state.
Bound payload extent and pad inner faces along each original wrist jaw axis. Retain feasible occluded geometry and all applicable uncertainty terms.
Use a partial second mark only with independent current optical evidence for identity and geometry.
Return unknown when required raw measurements are unavailable. Do not derive missing pixels or surface observations from predictions or labels.

gap_outcomes.certified: Both valid lower bounds strictly exceed 0.25 mm.
gap_outcomes.physically_inadequate: At least one valid upper bound is at or below 0.25 mm.
gap_outcomes.unknown: Required evidence is unavailable or the feasible interval cannot establish either conclusion.

verification_order: Predict all 99 RELEASE rows with the offline labels inaccessible. Include unknown rows and reasons.
Freeze prediction rows, digests, code identity, calibration and configuration.
Join separately scored offline labels by episode, frame ID and checksum, verifying step alignment.
Report per-side interval coverage, false certifications, abstentions, support failures, per-fit chain lengths and per-feedback timing.
Check available negative controls and identify unavailable physical negatives as unverified.
fitting_acceptance: A positive shadow case requires the entire joint gate, covered intervals on claimed frames, zero false certifications and no missed feedback deadline. Unknown is an acceptable development outcome.
stop_conditions: Digest or exposure-join mismatch, label leakage or unfrozen predictions invalidate scoring.
Interval undercoverage, false certification, unsupported geometry, a failed negative control or deadline miss invalidates the affected certificate.
Unprovable support or separation remains unknown. Preserve the failed evidence and stop that qualification attempt.
Do not relax thresholds or cadence, change the scene, add physical steps or retune on holdouts.
promotion: Requires separate independent verification of the complete original joint gate before operational use or formal acceptance.
